name: agentic-web-conformance
description: Checks a published agent network against the Open Agentic Web MVP profile, and says plainly which checks it cannot make.
//engines: 22.18.0, not 22.0: this tool ships TypeScript and is run directly, which needs Node's type stripping, on by default from 22.18. There is no build step and nothing to compile.
//dependencies: Empty, and meant to stay that way. A conformance checker that drags in a tree of packages does not get run by the publishers it is for. Everything here is the standard library: fetch, URL, node:http in the tests.
